title: Hand Contract: The Tithe
summary: The Gilded Hand wants its gold. You're the one who collects it now.

dialogue.intro: A villager slips you a folded note sealed with a golden hand, and won't meet your eyes.
offer: 'Sixteen gold ingots for the Hand. Bring them here. Ask no one.' It's signed with a smile.
Because they told me to give it to you. Please just take it.
dialogue.return: The Hand is still waiting for its gold.
dialogue.reward: The villager takes the gold with shaking hands. Your cut is inside the purse.
dialogue.done: The Hand has its tithe. For now.
